== Overview ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-13-threshold|Threshold is a significant [[Abidan]] world that functions as a middle ground between [[Sanctum]] and lower-level [[Iterations]]. Due to its unique position within [[Way|the Way]], it is considered a natural marvel and is essential to the operations of all seven [[Abidan]] Divisions, though the [[Titans]] hold a specific claim over it. The world serves as a primary filtering location for natural ascendants from lesser [[Iterations]], acting as a first line of defense to protect [[Sanctum]] from potential [[Vroshir]]. Upon arrival, individuals are introduced to the world as a place to transition into life beyond their original limited realms. The [[Abidan]] use Threshold to evaluate the worthiness of adepts, who are then either permitted to remain or relocated based on their utility. The planet possesses inherent protective measures built into its structure, which are necessary to withstand massive energy outputs that might otherwise destroy its atmosphere. While it is a vital hub, the world exists in a state of instability, appearing as though it is constantly on the verge of collapse.}}

== Threshold: Stories from Cradle ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-13-threshold|Threshold is an [[Iteration]] containing the city of [[Northgate]] and serves as a vital middle ground between [[Sanctum]] and low-level [[Iterations]]. Characterized by its barred sky, this world acts as the primary line of defense against potential [[Vroshir]] incursions. Although it is a location that can be traded, the world does not fall under the jurisdiction of any specific [[Abidan]] Division. During recent events, the [[Reaper]] hauled himself out of Threshold, yet [[Cirian]] notably omitted any mention of this world from his report.}}
